subject: MercuryHealth onboarding: network allowlist, service accounts & SAML handoff
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@mercuryhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MercuryHealth onboarding: network allowlist, service accounts & SAML handoff

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. As promised, I’m consolidating the immediate access-control items that will unblock our pilot environment and the production cutover. Outlined below are the asks and owners. I attached a short checklist (redwood_access_checklist_v1.xlsx) with the minimal artifacts we need for the first-week run: SSO metadata, SCIM provisioning scope, IP allowlist ranges, and service-account ACL patterns.

High-level asks (short timeline in parentheses):
- SSO / SAML metadata (ASAP, ideally by Wed): metadata XML or IdP entity ID + ACS URL so we can import and test.
- SCIM provisioning scope & user groups (this sprint): list of SCIM attributes you want auto-provisioned + which AD group(s) map to Redwood roles.
- IP allowlist for pilot & prod (by Thu): CIDR ranges for both environments (we advise separate ranges for prod).
- Service accounts: intended workloads and least-privilege roles (by EOW): names, owners, and expiration/rotation cadence.
- Org policy constraints: any non-standard retention/KMS/HSM requirements or egress restrictions.

Owners on our side: Ben will handle service-account mapping and ephemeral SA recommendations; Priyom will lead SSO/SCIM integration and sequencing; I’ll coordinate IP allowlist testing and gate checks with your infra.

Next steps: can you reply with the SAML metadata file and the initial IP ranges? I’ll schedule a 30-minute test window once we’ve imported metadata.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@mercuryhealth.com>, procurement@mercuryhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MercuryHealth onboarding: network allowlist, service accounts & SAML handoff

Naomi —

Appreciate the clear list. Attaching the SAML metadata dump and a quick CSV for our current egress ranges (pilot/prod) — note that the prod range will be finalized by Thursday after an internal change window.

Attachments: mercury_saml_metadata.xml; ip-allowlist-range.csv

We want SCIM to sync: firstName, lastName, email, title, and a custom attribute mh:org_unit. We’ll map AD group RH-Eng -> Redwood Admin, RH-Prod -> Redwood Operator initially.

For service accounts: we plan to create two dedicated SAs for Redwood integration: redwood-ingest-sa and redwood-admin-sa. Tom’s infra team will own rotation and KMS binding. I’ll loop Tom in for the KMS/HSM policy bits. Procurement is CC’d for the contract/doc flow.

—Alice
Director, IT Operations
Mercury Health

---

From: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@mercuryhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: procurement / docusign link and KMS notes

Naomi — forwarding procurement details + our KMS owner note. Procurement expects the standard enterprise addendum; I’ve asked them to send the DocuSign envelope (attached). On the KMS side, we require customer-managed keys for prod only. We can use Redwood-managed keys in pilot if that shortens the timeline — confirm if Redwood supports both.

Tom —

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MercuryHealth onboarding: network allowlist, service accounts & SAML handoff

Tom / Naomi —

We signed off on the service-account pattern I recommended. A few implementation notes:
- redwood-ingest-sa: grant limited write to the S3 bucket + inference invocation role; ephemeral tokens with 1h TTL recommended.
- redwood-admin-sa: scope to admin actions for environment-specific maintenance; rotate keys quarterly (default).
- For prod KMS: we can accept a customer-managed key (CMK) with a cross-account policy; we’ll need the key ARN and an admin principal to test.

I’ll upload a short runbook for SA creation and rotation to the shared Drive link and add TTL templates. Once you confirm the CIDRs, Priyom and I will schedule the import test for Wednesday morning US-PST.

- Ben
Senior Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@mercuryhealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MercuryHealth onboarding: network allowlist, service accounts & SAML handoff

Thanks all — quick status update:
- Alice: received SAML metadata and CIDR CSV. Thanks — I’ve imported metadata into our staging tenant and created a test IdP mapping.
- Tom: noted CMK requirement for prod. Redwood supports CMKs for prod; pilot can use Redwood KMS. Please share the key ARN and a test principal when ready.
- Ben/Priyom: please run the import test Wednesday 10:00–10:30 PT. Priyom, can you send the calendar invite and test plan?

Action items (owners):
- Alice / infra: confirm final prod CIDRs (Thu EOD) and share CMK ARN (if prod CMK required) — external
- Procurement: complete DocuSign — external
- Priyom: send invite & test plan (by EOD Tue) — internal
- Ben: publish SA rotation runbook to Drive (done: link in related_links) — internal

If everything goes green after the import test we’ll open a 1-hour post-import verification window and move to pilot. I’ll drop a short checklist to procurement and CC legal for records.

Thanks —
Naomi
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_access_checklist_v1.xlsx; mercury_saml_metadata.xml; ip-allowlist-range.csv
